rules.flag_patch: 태극기 patch = RIGHT upper sleeve (ROK Army regulation: 부대마크 왼팔, 태극기 오른팔). Unit lightning patch = LEFT sleeve.
rules.vehicle_flag: small 태극기 on hull — vehicle_bible position (left hull side) is a vehicle marking, independent of uniform.
rules.k2_limits: K2 unprepared fording depth ~1.2 m — deeper water floods the rear engine air intake and stalls the engine (5화 SC_197/206). Engine off + APU: gun, turret and FCS still work; never justify 'asleep = cannot fire'.
rules.sui_cavalry_id: Sui horses/cavalry/generals on horseback = VEH_207 (never VEH_205 pontoon). Xianbei = VEH_206. Goguryeo cataphract = VEH_101.
